description: On one dynaset over F (IDs 1-8; N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70; S alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd, Null; D with a time part, a repeated date and Nulls; Q x, Null, y), for each criterion [S Is Null ;; S Is Not Null ;; Q Is Null ;; Q Is Not Null ;; Q = Null ;; Q <> Null ;; Q = 'x' ;; Q <> 'x' ;; NOT Q = 'x' ;; NOT (Q Is Null) ;; IsNull(Q) ;; Not IsNull(Q) ;; Q Is Null OR N = 10 ;; Q Is Null AND S Is Null ;; N Is Null ;; D Is Null ;; D Is Null AND N > 50 ;; Nz(Q, 'z') = 'z' ;; Q = '' ;; Len(Q) = 0 ;; Null]: FindFirst, then FindNext x2, with the same criterion; after each call read NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID. Asks how Is Null, comparison with Null, negation, IsNull, Nz and zero-length tests select rows holding Null, and the order of the successive matches reached by FindNext. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
